newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says preparing extra revenue-raising plans.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says preparing extra revenue-raising plans.

text.p: The Turkish government is preparing two more revenue-raising packages in addition to three it has already unveiled, each of which is expected to bring in about $10 billion, Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan said on Tuesday.
"The core of the fourth package is the sale of state lands and that of the fifth one is to earn the country all idle gold stocks," Erbakan told his party group in parliament.
He said that when completed, the five packages would have earned the economy a total of $58 billion.
Erbakan, who unveiled the third package on Monday which aims mainly at raising money through leasing power plants, did not say when he would announce the next two packages.
"All lands to be sold under the fourth package have already been determined and allocated," he said.

He said Turkish people had hoarded about 700 tonnes of gold in their homes as savings. "Some of this will be processed into standard gold and the owner can exchange it with foreign currency at any time."
He said the two packages would bring in $10 billion each but did not say when they would be put into action .
